layer_check.abstract: O Centro de Referência de Assistência Social – CRAS é uma unidade pública estatal de base territorial, localizada em áreas de vulnerabilidade social. sources.name: IBGE Census 2022 – household-head income by tract
sources.value_status_note: ok = number; suppressed = 'X'; not_available = '.'; both are missing, never zero.
sources.pct_outside_city_boundary_note: Not applicable (not a service layer).

method.hexagons: H3 cells intersecting the city boundary
method.interpolation: area-weighted from census tracts (uniform population within each tract)
method.income: sp_ibge_renda.V06004 (mean income of household heads with income), weighted by V06001 (all household heads) x area share; suppressed and unavailable values are missing
method.income_bias: The mean excludes household heads without income; the number of heads with income is not published by tract, so the mean cannot be adjusted and overstates income where many heads have no income.
method.vulnerability_score: 1 - percentile rank of income_est among populated hexagons with income (1 = lowest income)

comparison.note: rank_difference = percentile rank of vulnerability_score minus percentile rank of the comparison index mean group (both: higher = more vulnerable).
